name: glyphsift-ci-playwright
description: Playwright 1.65.0 for tests/demo/check_demo.mjs and tests/npm/check_browser.mjs. Not a dependency of glyphsift: CI and the owner install it with `npm ci --ignore-scripts` from the committed package-lock.json, so every package is pinned by integrity hash. Chrome is the installed one (channel: chrome); no browser is downloaded.
